name: Mrs. Knott's Old-Fashioned Chicken & Dumplings or Homemade Chicken Pot Pie
brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant (California Marketplace · Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Simmered white-meat chicken with pillowy soft flour dumplings (or flaky pie crust with tender carrots and potatoes) offers zero fried breading and soft, easily digested textures.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Old-Fashioned Chicken & Dumplings for the softest texture, and take a lactase tablet for the rich chicken-cream velouté gravy.
watchOuts: Contains dairy in the creamy gravy/crust—take lactase; pick around green peas in the pot pie if sensitive to pea skins
